senses.definition: n.pr.loc. E. of Jordan, in Gad (place of leopard) Nu 32:36 = Jos 13:27; 𝔊 Ναμραμ, Βαιθαναβρα, etc., v. also LagOnom. Sacr. 232, 2nd ed. 246;—mod. Tel Nimrîn SurveyEP i. 337 BdPal. 179, cf. also מֵי נִמְרִים Is 15:6, & RobBR i. 551.
